verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at support.claude.com and a Markdown rendering of the 'Get started with Claude Design' help article, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable, agent-friendly docs that cover the product. The llms.txt covers the whole Claude Help Center rather than Claude Design specifically, and nothing shows how deep the Design-specific coverage goes. Missing for 10: a Claude Design–specific llms.txt or llms-full.txt, first-party documentation promoting agent-oriented docs, and independent or hands-on confirmation of agents consuming them.
